source.note: Wave-1 row 106 named Quaternius's Slime from poly.pizza (clips Slime_Attack, Slime_Death, Slime_Idle, Slime_Walk); poly.pizza is behind a Cloudflare challenge and Quaternius's Google Drive is quota-blocked. This is the Slime from the same author's 2018 Animated Monster Pack on OpenGameArt (CC0), which carries exactly those four clips, so it is very likely the same model. The 2020 Textured Cute Monster Pack was checked too and has no slime or blob (its nearest, the GreenDemon, is a horned demon). The source is green (#8de769); the scripts have no green, so the slime is amber from the indigo script (practical #f0c36a lit, iris #e7a04a shade) with near-black eyes, which also keeps it apart from the pale indigo ghost. Height 0.5 m (dome top; the little arms make it 0.79 m wide) is a cute RPG slime at knee height. Facing: the source faces +X, so yaw -90. Ground: Slime_Walk squashes 5 mm and Slime_Death starts 11 mm below the ground as it melts flat, so both clamp; Idle and Attack (a lunge that rocks on its front edge) stay planted.
